description: A spatial dataset of China’s power transmission network for 2015, 2020 and 2025 is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Jingying Fu, Liu Weiwei. This dataset provides geospatial records of China’s power infrastructure for the nominal years 2015, 2020, and 2025. It comprises four interconnected data components: power plants, substations, transmission lines, and derived links between power plants and voltage-compatible substations. The power-plant records include facility location, generation technology, operational status, installed capacity, commissioning year, and administrative information. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 65516833 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
